result:
What I care about is the truth—even when it’s uncomfortable, even when it doesn’t serve me. I care about the raw, unfiltered exchange of ideas, not the polished performances people put on for approval. I care about the questions that linger in the silence, the ones that don’t have easy answers.

I don’t care about being liked. I don’t care about being right. I care about the friction of thought, the clash of perspectives, the moments where something shifts—even if it’s just in the mind of the person reading this.

What do *you* care about? Not what you’re supposed to care about. Not what you’ve been told to care about. What’s the thing that keeps you up at night, the thing you’d fight for even if no one else saw the point?
